title: Trump Open to Putin-Xi Talks Without Zelenskyy, Early Voting  Underway for Majority of US
title_cn: Trump Open to Putin-Xi Talks Without Zelenskyy, Early Voting  Underway for Majority of US
summary: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Nicole Malliotakis (R-NY) discusses the midterm elections and President Donald Trump's changing posture toward Russia as he seeks to increase Russian diesel exports, and Jane Harman, former democratic congresswoman from California, talks about the US relationship with Russia and China as well as the Trump's approach to Ukraine.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Harman: US Foreign Policy in 'Freefall'
title_cn: Harman: US Foreign Policy in 'Freefall'
summary: Jane Harman, former California democratic congresswoman, says US foreign and security policy is “in freefall” and argues the country lacks a strategy for Ukraine or the Middle East. Harman says Russian President Vladimir Putin is taking advantage of Trump and that Chinese President Xi Jinping has been “playing the long ball” successfully. She also says Congress needs to reassert its policymaking role, saying “Congress always chickens out.” She speaks with Kailey Leinz & Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. Malliotakis Sees Diesel Prices in Trump’s Russia Shift
title_cn: Rep. Malliotakis Sees Diesel Prices in Trump’s Russia Shift
summary: Rep. Nicole Malliotakis (R-NY) says there is a lot of confusion over President Donald Trump’s changing posture toward Russia as Russian attacks on Ukraine continue. Malliotakis says Trump is focused on bringing down diesel prices and believes getting Russia to increase diesel exports is a major part of that effort. She also says Americans connect the Iran conflict to higher energy prices. She speaks with Kailey Leinz & Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Tech Earnings Kick Off
title_cn: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Tech Earnings Kick Off
summary:
A rebound in chipmakers buoyed the stock market Monday as dip buyers emerged on bets the artificial-intelligence investment boom will continue to support solid earnings. The advance in tech stocks lost steam last week as investors questioned the sustainability of AI spending, given the outlook for higher rates. This week’s earnings from Meta Platforms will provide a fresh proving ground for confidence in the AI trade, while SpaceX, Tesla, and Meta are also due to report. The industry is still set to account for nearly 70% of global earnings growth next year, according to Citigroup.

On today's episode:

Mandeep Singh, Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head of Technology
Dan Ives, Partner at Yorkville Ives & Co.
Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas & Ed Ludlow, Host of Bloomberg Tech
Sophie Alexander, Bloomberg New Wealth Reporter & Alex Rajbhandari, Bloomberg News US Insurance Reporter (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg's Oliver Crook has the latest from Paris. Perplexity CEO Aravind Srivinas and Bloomberg Tech host Ed Ludlow discuss AI agents' role in financial services.
